description: 1st connection. Advisor flagged a real risk: src/qrpglesrc/f0803s.rpgle uses `chain (custCode) tokuim foundInd;` with foundInd declared as a plain `ind` field, but ilerpgref75.txt line 38795's free-form CHAIN syntax table names the third operand a 'data-structure', not a resulting indicator - free-form RPG may not accept this the way fixed-form CHAIN's resulting-indicator column did. rpglint's own parser is lenient and won't catch a real compile error. This connection compiles two minimal isolated test programs against &LIB's real TOKUIM file into the empty &LIB2 sandbox: (A) the exact CHAIN/foundInd pattern f0803s.rpgle currently uses, and (B) the %FOUND-based alternative the file's own header claims is the 'fix'. Both are read-only against TOKUIM. Cleans up (DLTPGM) both test programs afterward.

steps.sql: SELECT OBJNAME, OBJTYPE, OBJLIB FROM TABLE(QSYS2.OBJECT_STATISTICS('&LIB2', 'ALL')) X WHERE OBJNAME LIKE 'F0803%' ORDER BY OBJNAME
